svg.title: A forest only helps as far as the trees disagree
svg.desc: Ten training rows resampled into three bootstrap bags where about a third of rows in each bag are drawn dashed and marked out-of-bag and others are marked drawn twice, feeding three visibly different trees into a circled AVERAGE, beside a table of max_features against tree correlation 0.53 to 0.68 and accuracy, the variance formula with the correlation term circled in red, and two importance bar charts where a pure-noise customer_id column takes 0.8182 of the in-sample impurity credit and zero of the held-out permutation credit.
svg.text: A forest only helps as far as the trees disagree
1/e = 36.8% of rows are left out of
every bag. That is a free validation
predictions that flip on one row:
more features per split -> the trees
Var(avg) = rho . sigma^2 + (1 - rho) . sigma^2 / B
as B grows the SECOND term vanishes.
customer_id is a RANDOM PERMUTATION - pure noise. Impurity
importance gave it 82% of the credit. Dropping it RAISED test
...average in parallel, or correct in sequence? -> M3
